description.en:
The name of the software that you want to install.

You can call the [ListSoftwares](~~87216~~) operation to query the software that can be installed.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc install-software --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --application ABYSS_2.1.5 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
